reply.text:
I'm sorry about the knees. Knee pain after a ski weekend is one for a doctor or physio to look at, not something I can assess or reassure you about, so please get it checked before you load them hard. I can keep going on the training side with you while you wait for that.

On the swap itself: I can change your program for you. Before I do, tell me whether you want squats out of your next session only or for the rest of the block, and whether you want leg press in their place.
